Process-Oriented Compact Solutions
for Tool Inspection

Request Information Now

blocks.body:
Would you like to speed up your work processes? Then take the abbreviation when it comes to tool measurement and inspection. The ZOLLER »pomBasic« series is the ideal solution for a well-designed, cost-effective setup and manufacturing of precision tools.

Save yourself unnecessary trips to the measuring room—benefit from efficient processes and precise results in record time. With their compact dimensions, ZOLLER’s »pomBasic« inspection units can be positioned anywhere in the production area—for example, right next to the CNC grinding machine, in the goods receipt area, or at the tool dispensing station.

Request a 1:1 expert consultation now

Calibrating measuring machines on-site using certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG’s quality assurance process—this ensures reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

»»pomSoft« 2« Software

»pomSoft 2« software—is intuitive, provides an overview, and enables operators to perform reliable measurements. The 32" TFT color monitor meets industry standards and is integrated directly into the device.

spots.label: incident light camera
spots.text:
incident light camera

incident light camera

Incident light camera—whose axis can be finely adjusted manually or, depending on the application, is also available with CNC control. Depending on the model, a color camera with a zoom lens, a monochrome camera with a fixed aperture, or a monochrome camera with a zoom lens is available for micro-tool inspection.

spots.label: additional lighting
spots.text:
additional lighting

additional lighting

Additional lighting – enables transmitted light measurement around the perimeter. This allows for the measurement of outer contours, step lengths, point angles, and much more.

spots.label: Mouse and Keyboard Tray
spots.text:
Mouse and Keyboard Tray

Mouse and Keyboard Tray

Mouse and Keyboard Tray – a space-saving, extendable drawer that is ergonomically positioned under the machine table.

spots.label: Color laser printer
spots.text:
Color laser printer

Color laser printer

Color laser printer—ideal for log and list print—fits perfectly in a practical machine table.

spots.label: Drawing holder
spots.text:
Drawing holder

Drawing holder

Drawing holder – ideal for mounting drawings right next to the measuring area. The magnetic spherical joint allows for flexible alignment to the optimal position for the operator. Magnets make it simple to fix the drawings and exchange them quickly.

spots.label: Manual Fine Setting
spots.text:
Manual Fine Setting

Manual fine setting of the X-axis and Y-axis

Manual fine setting of the X- and Y-axes—is precise and backlash-free, making it ideal for process-oriented measurement of tools.

spots.text:
»»pomLightTube««

»»pomLightTube«« Additional Lighting

»»pomLightTube«« additional lighting—features an LED lighting tunnel that provides high-contrast lighting of the tool cutting edge using incident light. Additionally, spot lighting can be optionally installed to perfectly illuminate concealed tool geometries.

spots.label: Document and Accessory Storage
spots.text:
Document and Accessory Storage

Document and Accessory Tray

Document and Accessory Storage – located on the machine table, it offers sufficient storage space and convenient access to your documents and accessories.

columns.header: Automatic Inspection Using the Macro Function
columns.body:
Do you have repetitive measuring tasks and want to perform them effectively? ZOLLER has the perfect solution for this, too: Thanks to the macro function, repeat measurements can be saved simply and reliably.

A single click on your saved macro program is all it takes, and the measurement process runs automatically: simple, fast, and user-friendly.

blocks.header: Measuring Saw Blades Tooth by Tooth
blocks.body:
The saw blade holder expands the range of applications for »pomBasic«. It allows saw blades with diameters ranging from 150 mm to 600 mm to be clamped using reducer rings that correspond to them.

A ZOLLER »pomBasic« is simple, fast, and safe to use—three unbeatable strengths that couldn’t be more accurate. But its design also provides the foundation for measurements exact to the micrometer: The arrangement of the linear axes and the integrated cable routing—with the resulting ergonomics and durability—are unique in the market.
